Name: gzhynko's Pufferchicks for 1.6

Description:
My sleeping meds never kicked in so I'm up with yet another animal mod at the crack of dawn (my time anyway lol). Permissions were open for gzhynko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6162]Pufferfish Chickens[/url] so I bring you the notorious Pufferchick as a coop animal! 

Pufferchicks can be bought at Marnie's and they'll produce eggs that can be turned into mayo.

Enjoy!
